title: Level 1 Functional Documentation Traceability
goal: Classify Level 1 functional elements and complete PowerShell if/elseif/else branch alternatives so public parameter gates are documentation-traceable, purpose and design comments are retained as semantic evidence, and internal control flow is excluded from top-level documentation completeness findings.

branch_refinement.public_parameter_scope: public command and exported module parameters only

parameter_help_audit.acceptance: Every public PowerShell script parameter and exported-module-function parameter is inventoried independently of conditional use; help compliance is reported separately from parameter-gate documentation coverage.

public_parameter_gate.acceptance: A documented parameter name is found in the ordered documentation hierarchy.

design_comment_gate.acceptance: Strong nearby comments are retained as semantic evidence and routed for semantic review; literal matching does not claim semantic equivalence.

internal_control_flow.acceptance: Local implementation mechanics are retained for navigation but excluded from top-level documentation completeness findings.

alternative_branches.acceptance: Every if and elseif condition is retained as a distinct branch record with branch kind and zero-based branch index. Every else is retained as a non-conditional fallback record and is not a parameter documentation failure.
